# czc-v2026.10.26.2 (0.2.18.1)

Brings in upstream sub2api v0.2.18 (54 commits) while keeping every local
customization. New: per-image billing for groups, scoped admin API keys,
quota limits for Vertex service-account accounts, plus upstream stability
and performance fixes. Gemini, Antigravity, promo codes and batch image
generation stay removed.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.26.1

### Per-image billing for groups (new)

- Groups on the OpenAI or composite platform with image generation enabled
  can switch on 按张计费 (`image_count_billing`). Image requests are then
  billed per image actually returned by upstream, not by tokens.
- Only images present in the upstream response are counted. The switch is
  checked per endpoint and pricing mode, so non-image requests in the same
  group still bill by tokens.
- Local hosted web-search billing (one charge per search round) is
  unchanged and is applied per round before the image check.
- Migration `248_group_image_count_billing.sql` adds the column (default
  `false`, so existing groups keep billing as before).

### Scoped admin API keys (new)

- 系统设置 → 安全 now creates admin keys (`adm_sc_…`) restricted by action,
  group, account type and platform, with expiry and IP allowlists. Keys are
  stored as SHA-256 digests; the full key is shown once.
- Only routes listed in the permission catalog are allowed. Local-only admin
  routes (VIP, risk control, security policy, account health, intelligent
  tests, anti-degrade, ops workers, etc.) are not in the catalog and are
  denied to scoped keys.
- Requests made with scoped keys are rate limited per key and every request,
  including GET, is written to the audit log.
- Site-wide read permissions (`groups.read`, `dashboard.read`, `ops.read`,
  `payment.read`) return full data, including local group fields.
- Promo-code and Antigravity entries were removed from the upstream catalog.
- Migration `247_scoped_admin_api_keys.sql` adds the `scoped_admin_api_keys`
  table.

### Legacy full-access admin key

- An existing legacy `admin-…` key keeps full access, including local-only
  admin routes.
- New legacy keys can no longer be created. Regenerate rotates the existing
  key only; regenerate and delete require step-up verification, and
  `/settings/admin-api-key*` accepts only a logged-in admin session.
- **Do not delete the existing legacy key**: automation that calls
  local-only admin routes has no other key type that can reach them.

### Accounts

- Vertex / service-account accounts support quota limits and show the
  quota bar in the account list.
- Account list platform and status filters are remembered.
- Clearing an account error inside the scoped-key transaction no longer
  waits on its own row lock.

### Gateway and streaming

- Chat Completions and Responses requests to Anthropic accounts:
  - If upstream sends `event: error` before anything reached the client,
    the request now switches account and retries; that attempt is not
    billed (previously the error was returned and billed).
  - If output had already started, the client receives the error frame and
    the observed usage (including kiro-rs `error.usage`) is billed, same as
    `/v1/messages`.
  - Streams that stop without a terminal event, idle out or hit a read
    error now end with a protocol error frame instead of a fake success,
    and usage seen so far is billed.
  - After a client disconnects, the gateway keeps reading upstream to
    collect final usage before billing.
- OpenAI streams: empty delta/done events no longer count as output, so an
  empty-stream overload can still be retried on another account;
  `Retry-After` / `Retry-After-Ms` are honored (max 8 s) for same-account
  retries.
- Cloudflare 1010 blocks no longer put the account into a 403 penalty.
- DeepSeek image inputs are sent with `image_url` only (previously
  `image_url` and `url` duplicated the base64 data; large images failed
  with 502/413).
- Codex outbound identity is unchanged: the local `codex-tui` identity and
  User-Agent trailer stay; upstream's switch to `codex_cli_rs` is not
  applied.

### Performance

- Scheduler snapshot decode results are cached in process memory.
- Model rate-limit snapshots use copy-on-write; model-mapping signatures
  are order-independent and allocation-free.
- Account quota increments only update the configured period columns.

### Dependencies

- dompurify 3.4.17 (GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7, GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr); Go 1.27.3
  toolchain alignment.

## VERSION

`0.2.18.1`

## Upgrade guidance

- Two migrations run automatically on start: `247_scoped_admin_api_keys.sql`
  (new table) and `248_group_image_count_billing.sql` (new column, metadata
  only). Both are additive. Upstream migration 246 (Gemini image groups) is
  not included.
- The API key auth cache snapshot version moves from 25 to 26, so cached
  API key snapshots are rebuilt on first use after restart.
- No configuration change is required.

## Compatibility

- Billing changes only for groups where 按张计费 is turned on.
- Compat-stream error events before output now fail over instead of
  returning an error to the client.
- Legacy admin keys cannot be newly created (see above).

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.26.1`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.26.2-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Migrations 247 and 248 are
additive; the older binary ignores the new table and column, so no database
rollback is needed. Scoped admin keys stop working after rollback.
